freetts_key_help: required - the free tier appends a spoken "generated with freeTTS.org"
piper_server_help: Address of the Piper HTTP server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5000
piper_speaker_help: Only for voices with several speakers: name or number. Empty - default
piper_voice_help: Empty - the default voice of the server
optional - If player does not work: optional - If player does not work
test_generate_tooltip: The text will be only generated and not played. The generated file will be opened in a new browser tab
test_text_help: If the field is empty, a test sentence in the language of the engine will be used
tooltip_command: This command will be executed, to use the custom system player
tooltip_type: Specify where the voice must be played
browser_instance_help: vis: ID of the browser or FFFFFFFF for all. Aura: comma-separated client IDs, empty for all dashboards
Announcement with the chime of Alexa: Announcement with the chime of Alexa
info_no_restore: The current playback (e.g. music from Spotify) is stopped and not restored after the text. If a volume is given for the text, the device keeps this volume afterward.
info_bose: Only some SoundTouch models support announcements (e.g. SoundTouch 10, 20 and 30 Series III): the current playback is paused and resumed afterward. The speaker checks the app key at the Bose cloud, which was shut down on May 6, 2026. Without a replacement of the Bose cloud the speaker may reject the announcement.
info_no_restore_kodi: The current playback is stopped and not restored after the text. Kodi clears its music playlist for the text and switches to the fullscreen player.
asterisk_callerid_help: Number shown to the callee. Empty - anonymous call
asterisk_repeat_help: Empty - default of the asterisk adapter (5 times)
info_asterisk: Every text is a separate phone call, so the announcement sound is not played. sayit and the asterisk adapter must run on the same host, because the asterisk adapter reads the generated mp3 file from the disk.
